catalog.name: Union of Giants
catalog.description: Every soldier hits harder. Future recruits included.

catalog.name: Night Shift
catalog.description: Houses recruit faster, up to the population limit.

catalog.name: Trigger Fingers
catalog.description: Fire rates soar. Ammunition? We will worry about that later.

catalog.name: This Neighbourhood Is Ours
catalog.description: Soldiers reach enemies well beyond their base range.

catalog.name: Unbreakable Tenants
catalog.description: Multiplies maximum and remaining soldier health.

catalog.name: Reinforced Denial
catalog.description: Increases maximum and remaining health of standing houses.

catalog.name: It Grows Back
catalog.description: Houses regenerate much faster. Ruins remain ruins.

catalog.name: Condominium Cannon
catalog.description: Multiplies the damage of every locomotive shot.

catalog.name: Armoured Train
catalog.description: Multiplies convoy health, including current and future carriages.

catalog.name: Absolute Right of Way
catalog.description: Multiplies collision damage against monsters without increasing wear.

arrival.speaker: locataire
arrival.text: You drew a circle, then wrote “our home” inside it.

reply.speaker: monsieur
reply.text: We wanted somewhere to come back to.

choices.text: Show me what the line cut through.
The walls prove this is our home.

listened.speaker: locataire
listened.text: We wanted to come home too.

claimed.speaker: locataire
claimed.text: A wall only proves you stopped looking behind it.

arrival.speaker: locataire
arrival.text: Your houses have walls. Ours had passages.

reply.speaker: monsieur
reply.text: If I open a passage, who protects the people behind me?

choices.text: Let us keep a passage between us.
Let us wait until the end to decide.

opened.speaker: locataire
opened.text: A door can protect without being locked on both sides.

closed.speaker: locataire
closed.text: Then the end will decide for us.

arrival.speaker: locataire
arrival.text: When the circle reaches both houses, who will have to leave?

reply.speaker: monsieur
reply.text: I no longer want “us” to need an outside.

answer.speaker: monsieur
answer.text: What do you do with the key?

choices.text: The door will open both ways.

invited.speaker: locataire
invited.text: I heard you. Let us see if the house can do the same.

kept.speaker: locataire
kept.text: A key can also lock in the person holding it.

harmony.title: A Home Together
harmony.text: The vortex stops growing. The Gentleman asks: “What if the house was never ours?” The Tenant replies: “It was never ours either. Perhaps it can hold all of us.”

force.title: You Held the Line
force.text: You survived five minutes and defeated every wave. The vortex still takes the city, but the convoy endured. This is a hard-earned survival victory; a shared home is another kind of triumph.

departure.title: You Made It Through
departure.text: The convoy survived until the end. Not every wave was cleared, and the vortex takes the city. You held on long enough to carry the memory of home with you.

defeat.title: The Lost Convoy
defeat.text: The houses leave their lights on for a train that never returns.

soldiers.name: Guardian
soldiers.role: Shields nearby allies from 40% of enemy fire. Protection does not stack.

soldiers.name: Watcher
soldiers.role: Pierces armour. Needs Scout marks to hit fast enemies. Minimum range: 3.

soldiers.name: Gunner
soldiers.role: Rapid fire against light enemies. Low-calibre shots struggle against armour.

soldiers.name: Scout
soldiers.role: Marks enemies for 3 s: other profiles and the train deal 35% more damage.
